verdict.rationale: Merge requests are clearly a core GitLab construct. Issues become merge requests, security findings and code reviews surface directly in them, Chat can search them, and the GitHub importer carries over pull requests and their review comments. However, no evidence directly documents the propose, discuss and merge lifecycle itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of creating MRs, threaded review discussion, approvals and the merge action itself, and hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
